The unknowns added to `decisions/open-unknowns.md` during slicing (the #674 ledger plus slicing discoveries) are not characterized in available context. Whether any are architectural and could threaten slice boundaries or force a re-plan mid-build is unknown.

The base of each chain (#576 and #569 respectively) must land before anything downstream can move. Neither chain's current blocker or active owner is stated in available context.
